title: HydraFusion updates and new Max option
key_facts: HydraFusion orchestrates multiple AI models to produce a single response, so users need not pick a model for each task.
It now has an updated model pool and improved orchestration workflows.
A new option, HydraFusion Max, is tuned for frontier capability on more demanding tasks with higher reasoning effort.
Both are available in VS Code, the GitHub Copilot app and GitHub Copilot CLI and remain in research preview.
Available on Copilot Pro, Pro+, Business and Enterprise plans with experimental or preview features enabled, subject to organisation model policies.
quote_evidence: HydraFusion orchestrates multiple models to produce a single response, bringing together their strengths so you don’t have to choose an individual model for each task.
Both HydraFusion and HydraFusion Max are available across VS Code, the GitHub Copilot app, and GitHub Copilot CLI and remain in research preview.
why_it_matters_hint: Copilot users get a heavier-duty multi-model option for harder coding tasks, still as a preview.
notes: Short changelog; no pricing, benchmarks or model names given.
